name: Blinded I
storyline:
Esclera keeps waking up in the same place. They don't know why they're here nor how long have they stayed. On thing is for sure, they want to get out.

Thankfully, they're not the only one. Cornea, one of the many trapped here, has found a way to ensure their escape. But they'll need a bunch of seemingly random stuff. And it won't be easy to get them...
summary:
Control Esclera in this graphic adventure where you'll need to get the stuff necessary for the escape. Talk to the odd people trapped here, and use the items you take to solve all the puzzles you'll find on the way.

Hope the eyes don't see what you're doing...
